123Invent Inventors Develop New Fan Blade Protector (BTK-425)

PR Newswire

October 10, 2025 1 min read

PITTSBURGH, Oct. 10, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- "We wanted to create a new accessory to help prevent dusty fan blades," said one of two inventors, from Gadsden Ala., "so we invented the FANTASTIC BLADES. Our design also enables you to enjoy a fresh and pleasing scent in the room."

(https://mma.prnewswire.com/media/2099578/InventHelp_Logo_jpg_Logo.html)

InventHelp Logo (PRNewsfoto/InventHelp)
The invention provides an improved accessory for a fan blade. In doing so, it helps protect against dust accumulations on fan blades. As a result, it increases safety and convenience when cleaning fan blades. It also offers a pleasing scent. The invention features a practical design that is easy to use and clean so it is ideal for households.

The FANTASTIC BLADES invention is currently available for licensing or sale to manufacturers or marketers. For more information, visit www.fantasticblades.net. Or contact Matthew Snell & Lashawna Smith at 256-919-9478 or email info@fantasticblades.net.
